items.summary: The Royals beat the Detroit Tigers, KC 3, DET 2. Michael Wacha led the night, working 7.0 innings with 2 earned runs, 3 strikeouts and 2 walks. Salvador Perez supplied the loudest Royals contact at 105.3 mph.
items.title: Royals at Tigers Recap
